root_cause.text: In mlx4_ib_create_srq(), after a successful mlx4_srq_alloc(), a failure in ib_copy_to_udata() causes the function to jump directly to err_wrid, which does not call mlx4_srq_free(), resulting in a resource leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a new error label "err_srq" that calls mlx4_srq_free(dev->dev, &srq->msrq) before falling through to err_wrid, and changes the goto target from err_wrid to err_srq on the ib_copy_to_udata() failure path.
